description: Find coin records by multiple puzzle hashes at once. Batch version of get_coin_records_by_puzzle_hash. Optionally filter by spent status and height range.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false)

puzzle_hashes.description: Array of puzzle hashes to search for (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex each)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_puzzle_hashes
